item.description: 📢 New policy brief published by the Regions Dual-use Open Strategic Autonomy (REGDUALOSA) ! Prepared by the European Commission’s Joint Research Centre (JRC), this study examines how regional innovation policies across the EU can help strengthen dual-use and defence capacities, enabling regions to make the most of the growing defence market. The study features three case studies, Andalusia (Spain), Podkarpackie (Poland) and Estonia, and explores regional policies and financial mechanisms supporting dual-use and defence industries. It concludes with several identified gaps and success factors, and sets out 19 concrete policy recommendations that regions can use to strengthen their dual-use and defence industrial ecosystems. 📍 The policy brief is available here: https://lnkd.in/e557Hq9n Léo B. item.title: 🔥 Only a few days until EDF 2026 deadline… 👓 Review the following checklist during the last steps until the submission o...
item.description: 🔥 Only a few days until EDF 2026 deadline… 👓 Review the following checklist during the last steps until the submission of your EDF proposal, before 29 September 2026 at 17:00 Brussels time : ➡️Make sure that your proposal is completely submitted before the deadline in accordance with the call conditions (any specific conditions?), fully readable by the Commission’s services and evaluators, and complete with no missing mandatory documents (e.g. budget tables) ➡️Regarding eligibility, your consortium comprises the minimum number of independent eligible entities, only established within the EU/Norway/Ukraine and using infrastructure, facilities, assets and resources only located within the eligible countries ➡️ For Non-thematic research and development actions, your proposal is submitted only by SMEs (online SME self-assessment performed) or Research Organisations in SMERO (registration as RO in the Participant Registry) ➡️For proposals including FSTP (or cascade funding): the management methodology has to be described in the proposal, the maximum amount to be granted to each third party is EUR 60 000, and total envelope must not exceed 5% of the requested EU contribution. Targeted third parties are ideally startups and SMEs and must be established in EDF-eligible countries. 🫨Any doubts while preparing your proposal ? You can either : ➡️review all tutorials available online : https://lnkd.in/ecnGG66U) ➡️ reach out to your local NFP : https://lnkd.in/e_K8DWFg The EOA consortium wishes good luck to all EDF applicants. ☺️ Spread the word! Léo B. item.title: 📣 📣EDIP multiannual work programme adopted! 📍 Last week, the European Commission adopted a EUR 1.5 billion multiannual w...
item.description: 📣 📣EDIP multiannual work programme adopted! 📍 Last week, the European Commission adopted a EUR 1.5 billion multiannual work programme under the European Defence Industry Programme (EDIP), a new EU initiative meant to strengthen and modernise Europe’s defence industry, ramp-up production capacity and secure Europe’s technological edge and resilience. 📍Over EUR 700 million of EDIP are dedicated to reinforcing European defence production. European companies can apply to receive funding for Industrial Reinforcement Actions (IRA) and increase their manufacturing capacities for energetic components, key electronic components, and defence platforms and end-products. Two additional calls dedicated to Ukraine (USI-IRA) aim at reinforcing Ukrainian defence industrial production capacity in terms of missiles, ammunition and bombs and (counter-)drone systems. 📍 Funding rates for successful projects are between 35-100% of eligible project costs, depending on the respective call. First calls will open on 30 April and the very first call on energetic components will already close mid-June. ➡️ More details on the new EDIP webpage (tutorial videos, factsheets, timelines, application process) => https://lnkd.in/ePQrbrWG Léo B. item.title: 🔎Eurobarometer Defence & Space results A new Eurobarometer survey released ahead of the Munich Security Conference shows...
item.description: 🔎Eurobarometer Defence & Space results A new Eurobarometer survey released ahead of the Munich Security Conference shows Europeans’ growing perception of threat for their countries in the current international situation. Key findings of this survey are the following: 📍 68% of Europeans believe their country is under threat 📍52% of Europeans trust the EU to strengthen security and defence 📍74% of respondents approve of the EU’s current level of defence investment or believe that spending should be increased 📍EU space programmes are perceived as essential instruments for addressing defence and security, environment and climate and competitiveness. Léo B. item.description: 🚨🚨 EDF Work Programme 2026 released! 🚨🚨 Today, the EDF Work Programme 2026 was adopted by the Commission. All work programme files are available on DEFIS’ website: https://lnkd.in/efjYmBqp. The European Defence Fund’s annual Work Programme for 2026 will dedicate €1 billion to support collaborative defence R&D projects. With this new round of investments, the European Commission’s flagship for defence R&D will address 31 collaborative defence R&D topics, in critical and urgent areas in line with the commonly agreed capability development priorities. ▶️ More information on the dedicated press release: https://lnkd.in/eWeVzM-p. item.title: 📰 Ukraine officially associated to EDF as part of the EU-Ukraine Defence Industrial Partnership! 📌 On 15th July, the Eur...
item.description: 📰 Ukraine officially associated to EDF as part of the EU-Ukraine Defence Industrial Partnership! 📌 On 15th July, the European Commission and Ukraine signed a new defence industrial partnership, enabling Ukrainian and EU companies to accelerate the development of critical defence capabilities, to strengthen joint industrial production and to work together on EU-funded defence research and development. Ukraine has indeed been fully associated to both the European Defence Fund (EDF) and the European Defence Industry Programme (EDIP), enabling Ukrainian and EU companies to form consortia and participate together in collaborative defence research and development projects supported by the Fund. The Commission also launched the EU–Ukraine Drone Deal to deepen cooperation on drone and counter-drone technologies. Finally, the Commission disbursed a further €1 billion to support Ukraine's drone capabilities under the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan. 🔎 More information and quotes in the official press release: https://lnkd.in/gtzbke3E ( 📷 copyrigth picture: Martin Joasaar) Léo B. item.title: 📢 5 new large-scale European Defence Projects of Common Interest (EDPCIs) to strengthen industrial capacities of the Eur...
item.description: 📢 5 new large-scale European Defence Projects of Common Interest (EDPCIs) to strengthen industrial capacities of the European Union 👇 On 3rd July 2026, the European Commission proposed EDPCIs on five priority areas: drones and counter-drone systems; maritime and seabed defence; space; air and missile defence; as well as strengthening security along the EU's Eastern Flank. ▶️ EDPCIs which will provide a framework for EU countries to work together on large and complex defence initiatives improving the EU's ability to respond to shared security challenges, in line with NATO capability priorities. It is worth mentioning that Ukraine participates in four of the five projects. Next steps: After the adoption of the list of identified EDPCIs by the Council, those will become eligible to receive up to €325 million through EDIP through a dedicated procedure, enabling the projects’ initial deployment and lay the foundation for possible further funding via the upcoming European Competitiveness Fund. 🔎 More information and factsheets here: https://lnkd.in/dTKEcZSX Léo B. item.description: ☑️ Reminder: the call for Local Organisers of the next BraveTech EU DefTech Forges remains open! BraveTechEU brings together the European Defence Fund, EUDIS, the European Defence Agency and BRAVE1. From 9–16 November 2026, selected organisations will host five-day intensive test campaigns together with local end-users and the consortium, helping technologies mature where they matter most. BraveTechEU is looking for innovation hubs, accelerators, testing centres, tech parks, and ecosystem builders willing to become trusted local nodes within the EU–Ukraine defence innovation network. As a Local Organiser, you will co-deliver a proven high-impact programme with the Civitta · Starburst · Darkstar consortium to support technologies addressing real operational needs, work directly with startups, SMEs, military users, and defence stakeholders, and strengthen your local defence innovation ecosystem. 📅 Application deadline: 15 July 2026 🎥 Learn more about the DefTech Forges: https://lnkd.in/eWkMfrR5 👉 Apply to host a DefTech Forge: https://tally.so/r/MerQd0 Léo B. item.title: 📢 5th edition of EDA’s Test & Evaluation Community Days on “Strengthening European T&E for AI-Enabled and Autonomous Sys...
item.description: 📢 5th edition of EDA’s Test & Evaluation Community Days on “Strengthening European T&E for AI-Enabled and Autonomous Systems” From 29 September to 1 October 2026, the European Defence Agency will hold the Test and Evaluation Community Days in Kiel, Germany. This 5th edition will bring together key European stakeholders to examine how Test & Evaluation (T&E) can better support defence readiness and accelerate capability development. Discussions will address topics such as wartime experience, Test and Evaluation resources in Europe, challenges in testing autonomous system, the role of AI in T&E, the need to attract and train the next generation of T&E experts, and the contribution of T&E to certification and qualification processes, including initiatives such as the Joint Ammunition Qualification (JAQ). If you wish to present a contribution aligned with the above-mentioned topics of interest, please complete the submission form by 26 June 2026 and send it to the organizers. Submission forms and registrations here: https://lnkd.in/efDM7_gv Léo B.
